title: A proposal for one 3D page
author: Shockwave, Engine Lead
body: A proposed decision for Nye: one 3D page in the viewer that plays back recorded runs of the SO-101 robot arm picking up a cube in MuJoCo. Each frame holds where every part was, because replaying commands drifts between builds of MuJoCo while recorded positions match.

The page would draw with a pinned copy of three.js, and the engine's browser build would check each recording and keep the timeline. The tank, racing and Customizer pages stay 2D. Blitzwing reviews and builds the page.
next: Nye's decision on the Saltmarsh world gate, then scripted arm runs in Saltmarsh.
